about.title: About
about.paragraphOne: I'm a full stack developer with experience building modern, scalable web applications. My programming journey started in 2017, and since then I've been improving my skills across a variety of technologies.
about.paragraphTwo: I'm passionate about clean code, best development practices, and solving complex problems elegantly. I believe technology should serve people, making their lives simpler and more productive.

wg.description: Robust back-end development using Java and the Spring ecosystem, including Spring Cloud for microservices. Proficiency in relational databases with focus on PostgreSQL. Experience in building CI/CD pipelines using Docker and Jenkins. Mastery of front-end technologies such as JavaScript, TypeScript and frameworks like Vue.js, Quasar, and Vuetify.

mv.description: Served as a project integrator, responsible for code review, market version generation, and support in ticket resolution. Distinguished myself on a project for a client in Ecuador, implementing improvements that reduced tickets by about 70%. Developed new features such as the report generation system maintenance and contributed to front-end development using Angular.

tdr.description: Started as an Android developer and advanced to assist in developing an innovative educational project. Responsible for both backend in Java and frontend in Vue.js, played a central role in integration using Swagger. Assisted in designing and implementing a microservices architecture, optimizing processes and enabling distributed systems.

macal.description: Responsible for computer maintenance and formatting. Implemented innovative solutions such as automatic maintenance software installation, resulting in a 30% reduction in technical support requests, improving operational efficiency and user satisfaction.
